description: [compact alias of list_export_presets] Lists all export presets defined in export_presets.cfg. Use before export_project to see available targets (Windows, Linux, Android, etc.).

includeTemplateStatus.description: If true (default), shows if export templates are installed.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to project directory containing project.godot. Use the same path across all tool calls in a workflow.
